trimmedBy: node trim-ats-a-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by nothing (whole body kept), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: A token that does not exist answers HTTP 404 with a JSON body {"status":404,"error":"Job not found"}. The slug is deliberately fictitious. No empty-but-existing Greenhouse board was found among the tokens tried (greenhouse, example, acme, demo, testco, sandbox), so an empty board is covered by a unit case built from the documented shape, not by a capture. Documented (https://docs.greenhouse.io/job-board.html): GET endpoints need no authentication ("Job Board data is publicly available"); only the application POST needs Basic auth. robots.txt of boards-api.greenhouse.io: User-agent * / Disallow: /embed/ only, so /v1/boards/{token}/jobs is allowed. The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. Job content is HTML-escaped by Greenhouse (entities) and the adapter decodes it once. company_name and first_published appear on every job of this response although the docs show them only in the single-job example. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
